rows.title: Selective bounce · episode rebound≥1z
rows.description: Later BOUNCE 1 refinement of the original strict daily entry edge. This adds a gate; it does not replace the 0.75z last 20-day rebound test or create a delayed retry.
conditions: Weekly top 150 by previous 30 completed daily quote volume, then 365-day listing age.
Prior 180 daily log-ratio SD 0.03–0.60, unaugmentedDF≤−2.86, trendR²<0.50.
Before the dip:180-day drift≤0.7SD; ≥5 opposite ±1SD transitions; every third spans ±0.8SD.
Last 20-day z-low≤−3 and ≥2 days old; rebound≥0.75z; currentz≤−1 and rising; first eligible condition edge only.
Episode log fall≥0.5 (39.35% ratio decline); short 3-day quote volume≥preceding 30-day mean.
Seven-day historical pair carry must be≥−0.5% per day. Missing carry blocks eligibility; price matches remain visible as unverified.
Additionally current z−canonical episode minimum z≥1.

rows.title: Opposing coin bias · strongest long versus strongest short
rows.description: Rank combinations of coins with strong opposing net directional votes across confirmed daily/4h setups. For example, a frequently qualifying long coin against a frequently qualifying short coin.
conditions: Vote source: fixed daily/4h First 20-style composite, including strict/broad range turns and extreme recoveries. Only actually confirmed families vote; pump-only or other watch setups do not. This is NOT a rerun of every catalog model.

Each distinct qualifying oriented pair contributes one long vote to its numerator and one short vote to its denominator. Multiple windows/families collapse. If both directions qualify, abstain on both.
Net coin bias = long votes minus short votes. Cross every positive-net coin with every negative-net coin. Zero nets are excluded; fresh synchronized snapshot marks required.

Rank by harmonic mean of the two positive directional net strengths:2×longNet×shortStrength/(longNet+shortStrength). Then combined net strength and directional agreement. This favours strong evidence on both sides; no expected-profit or probability claim.

Show BOTH long/short counts for each coin, their nets, range/extreme vote splits and whether the proposed pair directly qualified. Opposing individual biases alone do not confirm the cross-pair setup; those rows remain Watch.
Count full-universe sources before applying default held-token exclusion to final combinations. Daily/4h/1h selector changes chart detail only. Full per-coin counterpart evidence saved with each run.

Counts share tokens and market events and unequal history coverage. Indicative funding/spread/volume remain context; no verified execution eligibility, market neutrality or future return established. Existing searches and saved positions unchanged.

rows.title: Clean bases & highs · screenshot-style daily ranges
rows.description: Reusable numerical screen behind the 20October clean-bases TradingView list. Finds repeated low/high zones and cleaner swings, including recent bases after older trends. Visual review remains necessary.
conditions: Fixed 90/180/360 completed DAILY formations, excluding the latest completed close from fitting. All available unordered current-contract pairs; held-token toggle applied after scanning.

Inherited broad geometry:10th/90th log-close band at least 10%; each third width 0.45–1.8 times whole; at least 5 opposite 20/80edge transitions and 2 completed trough/peak phases each. First/final censored phases excluded.

Clarity overlay unchanged from screenshot study: formation drift and third-boundary shift at most 0.35band widths; turning-point MAD at most 0.15. Median completed crossing net/absolute-path at least 0.25; lower quartile at least 0.15.

Recent 30 daily closes: centered 3-close-median residual median at most 0.08band widths and 90th percentile at most 0.20. Latest completed close in inherited broad band tolerance−25%to 125%. No current edge or bounce confirmation required.

No liquidity, indicative carry or fresh-mark eligibility gate. Missing current mark stays unknown; outside current marks flagged. Complete valid consecutive DAILY OHLCV required. Ratios use synchronized leg closes, never nonsynchronous leg wicks.

Prefer 180/360context before 90-only, strict geometry, multiple passing windows, lower shift+MAD, higher crossing efficiency, longer window. Retain longest passing window per canonical alphabetical chart pair; not a long/short recommendation.

The old list included 42manual vetoes and 50discretionary priority choices; this button reproduces its numerical 268matches on the original snapshot, not human chart decisions or guaranteed profit. No saved manual veto is imposed on future data.
